## Highlights

- Adds Markdown, plain-text, ANSI, and canonical-Carve render targets.
- Adds portable HTML and Markdown import entry points with structured reports.
- Updates the embedded engine to released carve-rs 0.1.4 and exposes its
  extension registry directly.
- Incorporates the current importer, table, task-list, grouping, and source
  position conformance fixes.

The packed npm artifact is corpus-gated against the specification commit pinned
by the embedded engine before trusted publishing can run.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/markup-carve/carve-wasm/compare/v0.1.0...v0.1.1
